mapper.update: update cms_registration set verification_status = 1, verification_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and owner_type = 2 and (purchase_kind is null or purchase_kind <> 3) and payment_status = 2 and registration_status = 2 and (verification_status is null or verification_status <> 1) and exists ( select 1 from cms_activity a where a.id = cms_registration.owner_id and a.cancel_time is null and (a.del_flag is null or a.del_flag <> 2) and a.end_date is not null and a.end_date <= date_sub(now(), interval #{bufferDays} day)) and not exists ( select 1 from refund_application ra where ra.source_type = 'registration' and ra.source_id = cms_registration.id and ra.status in (0, 1) and (ra.del_flag is null or ra.del_flag <> 2)) and not exists ( select 1 from activity_cancel_manual_refund_case c where c.parent_order_no = cms_registration.parent_order_no and c.payer_member_id = cms_registration.member_id and c.status <> 'NO_REFUND' and ((cms_registration.owner_type = 2 and c.activity_id = cms_registration.owner_id and c.topic_id is null) or (cms_registration.owner_type = 1 and c.topic_id = cms_registration.owner_id and c.activity_id is null)) and (json_contains(c.verified_registration_ids_json, cast(cms_registration.id as char)) or json_contains(c.unverified_registration_ids_json, cast(cms_registration.id as char))) )

update cms_registration set verification_status = 1, verifier_id = #{verifierId}, verification_time = now() where id = #{id} and (verification_status is null or verification_status <> 1)

and not exists ( select 1 from activity_cancel_manual_refund_case c where c.parent_order_no = cms_registration.parent_order_no and c.payer_member_id = cms_registration.member_id and c.status <> 'NO_REFUND' and ((cms_registration.owner_type = 2 and c.activity_id = cms_registration.owner_id and c.topic_id is null) or (cms_registration.owner_type = 1 and c.topic_id = cms_registration.owner_id and c.activity_id is null)) and (json_contains(c.verified_registration_ids_json, cast(cms_registration.id as char)) or json_contains(c.unverified_registration_ids_json, cast(cms_registration.id as char))) )
mapper.select: select c.id is not null from cms_registration r left join activity_cancel_manual_refund_case c on (c.parent_order_no = r.parent_order_no or (c.case_type = 'PARTIAL_CHAPTERS' and c.payer_registration_id = r.id)) and c.payer_member_id = r.member_id and c.status <> 'NO_REFUND' and ((r.owner_type = 2 and c.activity_id = r.owner_id and c.topic_id is null) or (r.owner_type = 1 and c.topic_id = r.owner_id and c.activity_id is null)) and (json_contains(c.verified_registration_ids_json, cast(r.id as char)) or json_contains(c.unverified_registration_ids_json, cast(r.id as char))) where r.id = #{id} order by c.id limit 1 for update

update cms_registration set real_name = #{realName,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiCryptoTypeHandler}, phone = #{phone,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiCryptoTypeHandler}, phone_hash = #{phone,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiBlindIndexTypeHandler}, email = #{email,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiCryptoTypeHandler}, address = #{address,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiCryptoTypeHandler} where id = #{id} and phone_hash is null
mapper.select: select r.member_id as memberId, max(case when not exists ( select 1 from cms_topic_chapter c where c.topic_id = #{topicId} and c.required = 1 and (not exists (select 1 from cms_topic_node n where n.chapter_id = c.id and n.topic_id = #{topicId} and n.status = 1 and n.template_id > 0) or exists (select 1 from cms_topic_node n where n.chapter_id = c.id and n.topic_id = #{topicId} and n.status = 1 and n.template_id > 0 and not exists (select 1 from player_node_progress p where p.member_id = r.member_id and p.activity_id = r.owner_id and p.topic_id = #{topicId} and p.node_id = n.id and p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = 0))) ) then 1 else 0 end) as completed from cms_registration r join cms_activity a on r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = a.id where a.topic_id = #{topicId} and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 and r.purchase_kind = 3 and exists (select 1 from player_node_progress p where p.member_id = r.member_id and p.activity_id = r.owner_id and p.topic_id = #{topicId} and p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = 0) group by r.member_id
